deprecations.name: lr-geojson-view
deprecations.rationale: lr-geojson-view is the pre-v9 name of lr-geojson-viewer and adds no behavior of its own; it survives only as a distinct subclass so both names can share one registry. This reverses the earlier promise to keep the alias permanently: the tag, the LyraGeojsonView class and its geojson-view routes keep working unchanged through the 22.x line, and connecting the tag logs a one-time development warning.
